listings.Job Description: Join our organization as a Learning & Development intern, and you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, develop professionally, and be part of a supportive and successful team. The Learning & Development Intern represents the Mandarin Oriental culture and complies with the hotel L&D standards, actively fostering a positive learning environment and driving service excellence. Responsibilities include coordinating various learning & development activities, maintaining records, promoting learning culture, ensuring compliance with documentation, and communicating all L&D activities clearly.
listings.Job Requirements: Demonstrate learning agility and drive for continuous improvement, detail-oriented with the ability to multitask and meet deadlines, collaborate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders, good analytical and problem-solving skills, excellent communication and interpersonal skills, and proficiency in using relevant software and tools.

listings.Job Description: We are looking for a passionate personality to join us for 6 months' internship. The HR Intern will have an amazing opportunity to gain exposure within the Human Resources division, related to school requirements.
As an intern in Guest Relations, you will work closely with the Guest Relations Team to meet and exceed guest expectations by providing efficient and courteous Guest Relations service.
listings.Job Requirements: Candidate must be available to start in March, 2025.

listings.Job Description: As a Marketing Intern, you will support the marketing team in various aspects of all marketing campaigns and activities in the Hotel.
